correctedState: Scope the row to the non-Claude paths. On the Claude provider path the watchdog is NOT missing: the fork spawns the upstream native `claude` binary (options.ts:271-296 -> pathToClaudeCodeExecutable; claude-agent.ts:1/:1636), that binary implements the stream idle watchdog with CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG / CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS (its default is gated on `tengu_event_watchdog_default_on`, fallback false, in this bundled build), and buildClaudeSubprocessEnv passes the env through untouched, so the documented knob works. What is genuinely absent is an idle abort-and-retry on the fork's OWN streaming paths: the Nessy-Gateway SSE relay reads to EOF with no idle timer (packages/pi-agent-server/src/gateway-proxy/nestor-reasoning-proxy.ts:210-225), the Nestor-cloud A2A SSE reader does the same (packages/shared/src/agent/backend/nestor-cloud/client.ts:262-282), and the Pi SDK's only per-request bound is `timeoutMs` mapped to the OpenAI/Anthropic client `timeout` (@earendil-works/pi-ai dist/types.d.ts:85-88), with an idle timer existing only for the Codex-Responses WebSocket transport (dist/api/openai-codex-responses.js:874-963). No NESSY_* on/off knob exists for a model-stream idle watchdog on those paths.
